scope: Pack Suspension Run notification consumer and page delivery dispatch
summary: Added a stable Run suspension consumer with current grant, registry, source admission, Run lock, PinSet identity and exact capability checks. Delivery now dispatches Action and Run targets while rejecting unknown subjects or a missing Run admission. The durable effect is a RunPackSuspensionObservation with current Run and task snapshots, deduplicated by the original event and stable consumer id.

finalCheck.note: The 7 default skips are the pre-existing Cosign-gated cases; the focused Run suspension regression was executed separately with real Cosign and passed.

boundaries: Suspension observation does not cancel, pause or compensate a Run
No cross-scope production scheduler, subscription backfill watermark or managed worker host
No retirement reference-watermark governance, production Provider or independent security review
